_note: The 3D city films. 'proverb.tr' is what the aeroplane writes in smoke, one entry per line (keep lines short). 'photos' are William's real photos for the polaroids on the bench: put them in the photos/ folder with these names (square crops look best). Cities without a 'text' block don't have a 3D film yet and play their painted film.

proverb.en: Drop by drop, a lake is formed.

hill.tr: Tepenin ardında bir şehir seni bekliyor.
hill.en: Beyond the hill, a city is waiting for you.

rise.tr: Ve şehir, senin için ayağa kalktı.
rise.en: And the city rose to meet you.

text.en: Just before the evening call to prayer.

text.tr: Kırmızı şemsiyesiyle, her zamanki gibi erkenden gelmiş.
text.en: With her red umbrella, early as always.
At the ferry pier, strong and hot.
Emirgan Grove, a thousand thousand tulips.

proverb.en: A friend shows on a dark day.
Patience is bitter, its fruit is sweet.
One hand alone is silent; two hands make a sound.
The caravan finds its order on the road.
Grapes ripen by looking at each other.
Don't leave today's work for tomorrow.
So much is born before the sun rises.
Mountains never meet, but people do.
Whoever loves the rose bears its thorns.
